Oliver: Quick life update  got promoted to Senior ML Engineer and... were expecting a baby in Oct! Could use help planning a tiny shower. Thoughts on days: Thurs lunch or Fri 3pm? Also cake vs empanadas vs pastries?
Maya: Congrats!!! 496 Both huge, Oliver. Thurs lunch works for me.
Jordan: So happy for you 389 Friday 3pm ok if we keep it short.
Priya: Congrats Oliver!!! I vote pastries (croissants ftw). I can bring decaf.
hr-bot: Congrats recorded. Please file promotion paperwork: https://intranet/reports/promotions and submit parental leave request when ready.
Oliver: Thanks all. Quick poll: reply with :one: for Thurs lunch, :two: for Fri 3pm; and :a: cake, :b: empanadas, :c: pastries.
Maya: :one: :c:
Jordan: :two: :b:
Priya: :one: :c:
Oliver: Awesome 60a Ill send an invite and a short RSVP form. Appreciate the support!
